# OpenCode Workflow Flows — DEPRECATED

> **Deprecated and removed.** `opencode-pr-review.yml`,
> `opencode-pr-comment.yml` and `opencode-issue-handler.yml` (the 6-process
> automation pipeline: PR review → discuss → task, issue review → work) have
> been deleted from this repository. `opencode-implement.yaml` was already
> removed earlier. Deletion in downstream repos is handled by the
> `sync-actions.yml` cleanup PR job.
>
> Only the select-model action (`action.yml` + `src/index.js`) and the shared
> `.github/scripts/auth.sh` remain. This file is kept as a pointer so the
> README link does not break; the full pipeline description was removed with
> the workflows.
